hypotheses.observation: The overall metric summary reports latency_ms max 904 with p99 77, and the "home" transaction summary reports latency_ms max 904 with p95 61 and p99 96. All other transaction maxima are lower ("checkout" 444, "cart" 187, "product" 108, "add product to cart" 78, "reset cart" 75).
hypotheses.possible_explanation: The single largest observed latency in the run may be attributable to one or a very small number of "home" samples rather than to a broad distribution shift, since the overall max and the "home" max are numerically identical while the overall p99 is far below that max. Candidate mechanisms (unproven) include warm-up/first-hit cost, connection or cache initialization, or a transient dependency pause.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Request sample-level records for the "home" transaction (elapsed time, timestamp offset from run start, response code, thread name) and determine how many samples exceed the p99, whether the 904 ms sample is at or near the start of the run window, and whether it repeats on a re-run of the same workload.
